author: fable-cursor
criterion: Steps read as individually cut, weathered stone with soft mossy edges like the reference, not extruded boxes.
note: At A the 20 treads are parallel, straight-edged slabs of even depth in one cool blue-grey tone: clean nosings, no moss or grass spilling over any edge, the flanks a hard straight line - a machined flight, not individually cut weathered stone. The reference's treads are irregular and chipped, warm (#746d5d), with grass and moss creeping over every nosing and the flanks eating into the treads. The auto gate (20 steps, 33 unique shapes, mossJoints) passes but none of that variation reads at 1280 px. Crop x 0.55-0.90, y 0.10-0.70.
